title: Update all state location fields

requirements.text: Replace all existing state location references in the booking form with updated state names, ensuring pickup and drop location fields reflect current Indian state names
acceptanceCriteria: All state location options are updated to current Indian state names
Pickup location input displays updated state options
Drop location input displays updated state options
Location selection functionality continues to work correctly after update

constraints: Do not modify the backend booking data model or main.mo file
Preserve existing location input functionality and validation
Maintain the current UI/UX design of location input fields
nonGoals: Adding new trip types or booking features
